Q4 2025 Quarterly Report - Acme Corp

Revenue: $12.4M (up 15% YoY)
Operating Expenses: $8.1M
Net Income: $4.3M

Key Highlights:
- Launched new product line in EMEA region
- Customer retention rate improved to 94%
- Hired 45 new engineers across 3 offices

Outlook:
Management expects continued growth in Q1 2026, driven by
enterprise adoption of the new analytics platform.
